claims.evidence: Witness report shows a Canon DSLR body with no readable exact model; sensor size/resolution cannot be confirmed from the provided observations.
No model number or specs are readable in the witness photos; burst rate cannot be confirmed from the body-only view.
Video capability/manual video settings are not verifiable from the visible camera body controls in the witness report.

risks.risk: Exact Canon DSLR model is not readable; specs (18MP/APS-C, burst rate, video features) may not match the seller’s claims.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model name/number on the camera body (e.g., on the front/bottom/side label) and the rear LCD/menu showing model info.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Canon DSLR body with unknown model/specs (worst-case spec mismatch).

risks.risk: Camera may be non-functional or partially functional (buttons/dials, metering, autofocus, ports), since no working test is shown.
risks.proof: A short clip showing the camera powered on with menu visible, autofocus working on a target, and at least one button/dial responding (e.g., changing modes).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possibly faulty until proven working.

risks.risk: Sensor health is unknown (dust, dead pixels, fungus) and lens mount condition is unknown (contacts/bayonet wear) because no lens is attached.
risks.proof: Photos of the sensor at maximum magnification (or a sensor-cleaning/inspection shot) and a close-up of the lens mount contacts/bayonet; plus a test shot of a blank wall/sky to reveal dust.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing cleaning/with possible sensor issues.

risks.risk: Physical condition (scratches, dents, cracks, worn rubber grips) is not documented; body-only photo may hide damage.
risks.proof: High-resolution photos of all sides: front, back, top, bottom, and corners; include close-ups of any scuffs/cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming average wear for a used DSLR body.

risks.risk: Battery/charger and memory card inclusion and health are unknown; camera may not come with essentials or may not hold charge.
risks.proof: Photo of included battery model/label, charger, and memory card; plus a clip showing the camera running on the provided battery and recording a short video to the card.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body-only or without guaranteed working power/storage until confirmed.

risks.risk: LCD/screen functionality is unknown; witness only clearly sees the viewfinder/eyepiece area, not the rear LCD.
risks.proof: A clear photo/clip of the rear LCD showing live view/menu and confirming it is not blank/black and responds to controls.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming LCD may be faulty or not included/untested.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the exact Canon model number/name on the body (front/bottom/side label).
Show the rear LCD powered on (menu visible) and a short clip proving buttons/dials/mode changes work.
Provide a sensor check shot (dust/fungus) and a test photo of a plain bright background to reveal sensor spots.
Show close-ups of the lens mount contacts/bayonet wear (since no lens is attached).
Confirm what is included: battery, charger, strap, cables, memory card (type/capacity) and show them in photos.
Record a short 1080p clip to the memory card and show playback to confirm video works.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Canon DSLR body, but the exact model and key condition/work-status details needed to price it safely are missing. Without proof of functionality and model/specs, any price would be too uncertain.
